title: Parties
summary: **Parties** let you group up with friends on ChromaPVP and queue team modes together. A party holds up to four players.

ul: `/party invite` and a player's name invites them. Inviting someone starts a party if you are not in one.
`/party accept [name]` and `/party deny [name]` answer an invite. You can also click **[Accept]** or **[Deny]** in chat.
`/party list` shows who is in your party.
`/party kick` and a name removes a member (leader only).

blocks.p: An invite runs out after 60 seconds. You can only be in one party at a time.
Only the party leader can queue the party. When the leader queues, every member is moved into the match once it is found.

ul: In the [Arena](/wiki/pvp/arena/), a party of two plays as one team in 2v2 and 2v2v2. In the other formats its players fight apart.
A mode refuses a party bigger than its teams.
If any member cannot queue right now, or is on another kit server, the party does not queue.
Any change to the party (someone joins, leaves or is kicked) takes the party out of the queue. Queue again when you are ready.
Make sure everyone is in the lobby or in FFA, not in a match, before the leader queues.
Clicking the invite link in chat is faster than typing `/party accept`.

history.text: Added parties: up to 4 players with `/party`.

needs_owner_check: What a party changes in FFA is not in the config (no friendly-fire or nametag setting), so FFA is not covered. Green party nametags (Release Q, TAB placeholder) are not in the ChromaticArena config; left out. Parties of 3 or 4 in the Arena are not described by the config.
